title: Social profile concept with scenic blurred backdrop, glass stats panel and sticker-decorated avatar
attribution_visible_in_image: Captions 'Profile concept' and '2/2026' beside the phone. No creator credit visible.
contains_third_party_content: Photos, the Figma logo and other brand logos in the subscriptions cluster.

observed.layout: An iPhone-style frame on a light page with captions 'Profile concept' and '2/2026'. Screen: blurred landscape photo background (sky blue to green); translucent back and more buttons; an oval avatar frame with a gradient outline, sticker-like decorations (Figma logo cluster, a sunburst, a blue sticker) and a blue '+' badge; name 'Kaia Bloom' (white), '@bloom'; chips (Bruges, Designer, July 31); a translucent green panel with two avatar clusters ('Friends +30' and 'Subscriptions +10'); tabs (Stories active, Posts, Saved, Tagged); a two-column photo grid with like counts; a floating blue '+' button with side icons at the bottom.
observed.hierarchy: Avatar and name, then the glass panel, then the content grid.
observed.typography: Neutral system-style sans; white over blur. Unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Round icon buttons, stickers, brand logos.
observed.materials: Heavy background blur, translucent glass panels, glossy stickers.

interpretation.aesthetic: Expressive, personalized profile; identity through imagery and stickers.
implementation_notes: Backdrop: user-chosen photo with strong blur and a gradient to dark toward the content.
Stickers: layered images with rotation over the avatar.
Glass panel: low-alpha tinted fill with backdrop blur.

concept_work.essence: A profile that looks like the person, with their subscriptions and friends shown as clusters on glass.
what_makes_it_work: Friends and subscriptions summarized as avatar clusters.
Clear tab row for content types.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The white name over light sky measures about 2.1:1 and the handle about 1.6-2.1:1.
Chip and panel labels over blur are low contrast (about 2.2-3.4:1).
The floating '+' button overlaps the content grid.
Stickers could hide the avatar face.

shared_tokens: translucent glass for chips, panel and buttons
links: The Figma logo appears both on the avatar and in the subscriptions cluster, linking identity to subscriptions.
The create button sits above the grid it adds to.

approach: Backdrop-filter blur on a photo background

pattern.name: Photo-derived backdrop with glass information panels
avoid_when: Text must stay legible over unpredictable photos without a scrim
must_preserve: A contrast guarantee for text over the photo
Separate the primary create action from the content
adaptation_examples: Music profile: backdrop from the latest album art, panel shows followers and playlists.
Travel profile: backdrop from the last trip photo, chips show places.
failure_modes: White text on light sky near 2:1

lessons: Text over a user-chosen photo needs a scrim or an adaptive text color.
Reuse the same logo to link identity decoration and data.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Light page and a blurred landscape photo as the screen background; blue for the create button; stickers add small bursts of color.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A personalized social profile with identity, relations and content.
Rich layered composition with a clear focal point at the avatar.
Profile conventions are followed, but text over a light photo fails contrast and the FAB overlaps content.
Tabs, counts and a create action are clear; the personalization controls are not shown.
Glass, rounded shapes and white text are consistent.
Sticker-decorated avatar tied to subscriptions is a distinctive idea.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 2.05:1; secondary text min 1.61:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
